name: @aethelred/wallet-notarization
description: On-chain anchoring for the off-chain audit Merkle trail. Every cadence tick (default 15 min), builds the root of pending audit events and submits it to a Notary smart contract. Produces AnchoredProof bundles — Merkle inclusion proof plus the on-chain batch record — that regulators verify cryptographically instead of trusting the operator's database.
